name: flow-slack-ask-connected
label: Send it to Flow in Slack
description: Your Slack account sends its code to the Flow app; the hub validates it. The step finishes by itself once the account is connected.

exe_data.detail:
**1. Open Slack** — [tap here]({{connect.link}}): it adds Flow to your workspace (or confirms it is there) and opens Flow's DM. Or scan:

![Scan with your phone]({{connect.qr}})

**2. Send** `link {{connect.code}}` to Flow there.

**3. Status:** waiting for your message…
